name: Atlassian Design System
principles: Bold, optimistic, and practical. Tokens are named so a picker can choose a role instead of a raw value.
color: Tokens for background, text, border, and icon, including inverse roles for bold surfaces. Alpha and transparent colors are part of the set.
typography: A product sans with a short heading and body scale.
spacing: A space scale used by stack and inline layouts.
shape: A radius scale. Many surfaces use a medium radius.
elevation: A small set of elevation tokens, including one below the surface (sunken). Each elevation color token is paired with a shadow token. Light mode builds depth with shadow. Dark mode uses shadow and color together.
layout: Page layouts with navigation, banners, and a main column.
icons: A dual icon set for 16px UI and larger spot illustrations.
components: Button, lozenge, flag, modal, dynamic table, and inline edit.
themes: Light and dark token sets. The same elevation roles resolve differently in each.
adapt: Keep the named elevation pairs and the token roles. Replace the Atlassian palette and illustration style.
